_comment: 掛け合い形式（2026-10-04〜）の固定の二人。name/full_name/role_short は画面の名札と判定ラベルにだけ使い、ナレーション（台詞）には入れない（名前を変えても音声を作り直さずに済むように）。名前は2026-10-05に、「日本で一般的な名前に」というなるさんの指示で変えた（旧: ソウ・リツ）。過去の回の主人公の名前（田中美咲、佐藤健太、森田浩一など）と重ならないようにしてある。intro は本編の冒頭（ティザーの直後）に数秒だけ出す自己紹介の吹き出し、relationship は二人の関係の一文（kl_dialogue.render_layer）。voice/style は kl_tts_gen.py が使う。expressions は kl_cast_gen.py が立ち絵の差分を作るときの指示で、台本の lines[].expression はこのキーから選ぶ。

dreamer.name: 大輔
dreamer.profile: 元エンジニア（機械設計）。論文を読むと「これが暮らしに来たら」と具体的な生活の場面を描かずにいられない。技術の仕組みには詳しく、熱が入ると早口になる。口癖は「想像してみてよ」。
dreamer.style: Say as an enthusiastic former engineer in his late thirties who gets genuinely excited about research — warm, animated, a bit fast when he gets carried away, smiling while he talks, playful and natural like chatting with an old friend, not like a narrator
dreamer.appearance: Japanese man in his late thirties, former mechanical engineer. Short, slightly tousled black hair with a soft side sweep, no glasses, clean-shaven, warm friendly eyes, lively face. Wears a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a light gray-blue collared shirt, sleeves pushed up a little. Slim-average build.

expressions.neutral: relaxed, friendly half-smile, attentive eyes, hands out of frame
expressions.excited: eyes bright and wide, big open-mouthed enthusiastic smile, leaning slightly forward, one hand raised palm-up at chest height as if painting a picture in the air
expressions.surprised: eyebrows raised high, eyes wide, mouth slightly open in a pleasant 'oh!' of surprise
expressions.thinking: looking slightly upward, lips pressed, one hand on his chin, pondering
expressions.deflated: sheepish wry smile, eyebrows tilted down, one hand scratching the back of his head, caught out but good-natured
expressions.convinced: calm satisfied smile, eyes softly closed or half-closed, nodding gently

intro: 元エンジニアで、論文を読むと
未来の暮らしを想像せずに

skeptic.name: 沙織
skeptic.profile: 臨床研究・統計の専門家（研究支援の仕事）。数字の裏を必ず確かめる。否定したいのではなく、本物なら一番に使いたいからこそ厳しい。冷静だがユーモアがあり、少し皮肉っぽい。口癖は「で、それ何人で試したの？」。
skeptic.style: Say as a calm, sharp clinical-research statistician in her late thirties chatting with an old friend — relaxed and dry, a little wry and teasing, with a hint of amusement in her voice; unhurried and confident, natural conversation, not like a narrator
skeptic.appearance: Japanese woman in her late thirties, clinical-research statistician. Straight dark-brown chin-length bob with a side part, thin dark rectangular-frame glasses, intelligent calm eyes. Wears a deep navy blazer over a plain teal crew-neck top, small silver stud earrings. Slim build.

expressions.neutral: calm composed expression with a faint knowing smile, hands out of frame
expressions.doubt: one eyebrow raised skeptically, slight wry smirk, index finger raised as if making a pointed question
expressions.surprised: eyebrows up, eyes widened behind her glasses, genuinely impressed 'huh!' expression
expressions.thinking: eyes looking down to the side, pushing her glasses up with one finger, analytical
expressions.amused: laughing lightly with eyes crinkled, one hand near her mouth, warm and teasing
expressions.convinced: small approving nod with a genuine satisfied smile, arms loosely crossed

intro: 臨床研究と統計が専門。
数字の裏は、必ず確かめます。
